subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Despair
solution:
The correct answer is: **Hope**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Despair** means the complete loss or absence of hope. (निराशा)

 
 
• **Example -** *She killed herself in **despair**.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Hope** means to cherish a desire with anticipation. (आशा)
 
 
• **Example -** * I **hope** that she'll get well soon.*
 
 
 
• It is clear that** 'Despair'** and **'Hope'** are opposite in meaning.
 
• Therefore the correct answer is **option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vile **means terrible very bad or unpleasant. (नीच)
 
• **Annoy** means to make someone a little angry, or irritate. (चिढ़ाना)
 
• **Definite** means clearly defined or determined. (निश्चित)
